about: Ten questions a shop's customers ask, worded the way they write rather than the way the documents do, each with the words a passage must contain to answer it (case and spacing ignored). Two more that the documents do not answer, to see what retrieval returns when the honest answer is 'not covered'.

answerable.question: Hi, I wore my new rain jacket on one walk and I don't love the colour. Can I still send it back?
I posted my return last week. Once you have it, how long until the money is back on my card?
I bought a sleeping bag as a Christmas present in early December. What's the latest date I can return it?
Do I have to pay anything to use your prepaid return label?
My aunt gave me one of your gift cards back in 2023. Is it still valid?
I'm ordering from Germany. Will I have to pay import tax when the parcel arrives?
If I order this morning, will it ship today?
The zip on my Fernhill backpack broke after three years. Will you fix it under warranty?
must_contain: hardware are covered for two years

answerable.question: How many hours does the Ember 400 headlamp last on its brightest setting?
What's the waterproof rating on the Kestrel 2.5L jacket?
